profile.name: Akshay Chavan
profile.headline: Building thoughtful digital products, from interface to infrastructure.
profile.intro: I’m a full-stack developer who turns ideas into real, working products. I build scalable web applications using Next.js, Java, and PostgreSQL, with a focus on clean code, user experience, and real-world impact.
profile.about: I am a software developer with hands-on experience building production-ready web applications, enterprise CRM modules, and microservices architectures. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology from Saket College with an 8.70/10 CGPA and completed professional Java Full Stack Development certification at Quality Software Technologies. My background combines corporate operations experience at Accenture with practical full-stack development at Zootechx.
profile.availability: Open to full-time software developer roles
profile.focusDescription: Building web applications, exploring new technologies, and continuously improving as a developer.
profile.contactIntro: I am open to software development opportunities. Feel free to reach out directly for collaborations, job opportunities, or just to say hello.
profile.footerDescription: Building web applications and turning ideas into real-world products.
profile.seoDescription: Akshay Chavan - Software Developer specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Next.js, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
